description: Every class pass, intro offer and membership Yoga Dublin sells, with its price in euro and a buy_url that opens it in Mindbody's cart. Use this for anything about what something costs or how to buy it. Passes work at all four studios. A contract auto-renews for the same term unless cancelled, so quote minimum_term_months with the price. A gift card comes back beside the offers, for any amount the buyer chooses, and is the thing to give somebody buying for another person.

category.description: intro is the new-student offers, class_pack is bundles of classes, membership is unlimited monthly

discipline.description: mat covers yoga, Pilates, barre and meditation; reformer is Reformer Pilates, which is priced separately

new_students_only.description: true returns only the offers a new student can use once
